bear_maw.name: Bear Maw
bear_maw.system.description: The maw of a large predator: step III of the Damage Ladder. Natural weapon: can't be disarmed and doesn't occupy the hands.

chimera_specimen_maw.name: Specimen Maw
chimera_specimen_maw.system.description:
A dog's maw set crookedly: step II of the Damage Ladder. Natural weapon: can't be disarmed and doesn't occupy the hands.

It isn't the maw that grabs but the specimen's human hands: mechanically it's Jaw Lock, in fact it's fingers at the throat.

chimera_watch_claws.name: Warden Claws
chimera_watch_claws.system.description:
Bear claws with a horse's strength: step III. A cheap slashing strike for Claw Slash.

Control Zone 1: it also carries the creature's size-based Control. The system reads CZ from the equipped melee weapon; the actor has no separate size field.

chimera_watch_maw.name: Warden Maw
chimera_watch_maw.system.description:
The guard chimera's main weapon: step IV, one step above the rank 3 row. This is what “hits hard” means: an elite buys a half-rank up in damage.

Control Zone 1: it also carries the creature's size-based Control. The system reads CZ from the equipped melee weapon; the actor has no separate size field.

matriarch_goat_horns.name: Goat Horns
matriarch_goat_horns.system.description:
The Matriarch's second head. Step IV, bludgeoning: her only weapon that can perform Ram.

Control Zone 2: it also carries the creature's size-based Control. The system reads CZ from the equipped melee weapon; the actor has no separate size field.

matriarch_lion_maw.name: Lion Maw
matriarch_lion_maw.system.description:
The Matriarch's first head. Step IV. The main head: if a player doesn't declare where they're striking, the damage is recorded against it.

Control Zone 2: it also carries the creature's size-based Control. The system reads CZ from the equipped melee weapon; the actor has no separate size field.

matriarch_serpent_head.name: Serpent Head
matriarch_serpent_head.system.description:
The Matriarch's third head: a tail ending in a snake. Step III: it hits weaker than the other two but carries a venom that neither DR nor resistance reduces.

Control Zone 2: it also carries the creature's size-based Control. The system reads CZ from the equipped melee weapon; the actor has no separate size field.
